title: An archive reads the proof first: `merge --idle-lanes --session <id>` prints a SAFE or UNSAFE verdict, and the archive hook allows on SAFE
why: Coordinator relay 14:29 CST Nov 18, from the consultant's read at 14:28 CST. Incident: the 14:20 CST archive of seven lanes (and three more at 14:23 CST) was judged from post-turn summaries, with the REST proof read after the plan (safe in the end, no loss). The owner at 14:21 CST: "Not confirming before archiving is itself possibly also a bug".
source: coordinator relay 14:29 CST Nov 18 (consultant's read 14:28 CST); owner 14:21 CST
note: Wish: `merge --idle-lanes` gets a per-lane mode, `merge --idle-lanes --session <id>`, printing the evidence for one lane (branch pushed or merged; each PR merged, or closed as replaced by a merged PR, by REST; the step landed) and one SAFE or UNSAFE verdict. Hook `lane-closes-after-records` then allows `archive_session` when that command printed SAFE for the session at its current state, in place of the tag-only read. This absorbs step lane-close-reads-branch-pr and fixes the no-`cs-step` refusal. Needs a test-author first; prior-work search first. The consultant says do not build it now.
